text:
Bill Belichick and Jordon Hudson have now done something wrong for the Falcons. (Photo by Christopher Polk/Variety through Getty Images)
Bill Belichick has enough history with the Falcons of Atlanta, and his girlfriend, Jordon Hudson, is apparently aware of that.
In New Orleans for the Super Bowl Lix, Belichick and Hudson were seen walking out of Saturday, with Hudson making the curious fashion choice of a shirt that celebrates the victory of the Falcons in the Super Bowl Li.
Obviously, the Falcons did not win the Super Bowl Li. The New England patriots of Belichick did it, erasing a deficit of 28-3 in the third quarter in one of the most famous returns in the history of sport. The Belichick-Falcons connection also came into play last year, when he interviewed his vacancy coach and was rejected for his chief coach and was rejected
Then Hudson apparently decided to make a trolling. New Orleans fans around them probably don’t care.
Bill Billichick’s GF Jordon Hudson, 24, trolled the Atlanta Falcons with a Super Bowl Li champions shirt in New Orleans today.
Obviously, Atl collapsed, and these shirts never saw daylight, until today.

By TMZ The couple ran into the NFL commissioner Roger Goodell, while they were out and met for a double appointment with announcer Jim Gray and his wife.
Belichick, now the chief coach of North Carolina, and Hudson previously presented themselves at the Honors of the NFL on Thursday, with Belichick wearing her Super Bowl rings, including the one she obtained by winning the Falcons, while Hudson looked her Own Porristas championship ring.
The relationship between the 72 -year -old coach and the 24 -year -old has drawn attention for obvious reasons. The Honor presenter of the NFL Snoop Dogg made a joke on the couple, remembering a time when the Dallas Cowboys were good, the Kansas City bosses were bad and Hudson was not born yet.
